description: Source code for the Coordinates class in the libqhullcpp library, implementing a vector of coordinate values with various methods for manipulation, access, and search.

classes.name: Coordinates
classes.description: A class representing a vector of coordinate values (coordT), with methods for element access, modification, and search.

methods.name: mid
methods.description: Returns a subvector of coordinates starting at index 'idx' with length 'length'.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the coordinate at index 'idx' or a default value if out of range.

methods.name: operator+=
methods.description: Appends another Coordinates object to this one.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends coordinate values from a pointer array with specified dimension.

methods.name: takeAt
methods.description: Removes and returns the coordinate at a specified index.

methods.name: takeLast
methods.description: Removes and returns the last coordinate.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the coordinates at two specified indices.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a coordinate value exists in the vector.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of occurrences of a coordinate value.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Finds the index of a coordinate value starting from a given position.

methods.name: lastIndexOf
methods.description: Finds the last index of a coordinate value starting backward from a given position.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all instances of a specific coordinate value.
